digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program and epic completion attestation
propositions: A 344-bug corpus analysis identified recurring escape channels including surface-parity gaps, contention semantics, inert config, wall-clock flakes, unlocked store writes, and missing plan review gates.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must detect raw git writes bypassing the store, unread config schema fields, wall-clock assertions in tests, incomplete AC checkboxes at close, dead code references, and oversized bug-fix diffs without review attestation.
Production shell logic (reconcile-bridge, canary workflow, probe harness, vote normalizer) must be migrated to Python per strangler-fig policy with end-to-end typing and property-test pinning.
The bug provenance system must capture detected-by context at creation and enable trend-queryable metrics without requiring new user input.
Code comments citing dead identifiers (SHAs, run-ids, dates) must be remediated to ticket citations with CI guard preventing regression.

An epic originally closed without a signed completion attestation (96d1) was fixed by grandfathering pre-normalization children and re-running the completion verifier through the codebase-sanctioned recovery path.
